mainEntity.name: What is an in-law addition and what does it typically include?

acceptedAnswer.text: An in-law addition provides private living space within or alongside your home for aging parents, adult children, or extended guests. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms designs these suites to balance independence and shared family living. Scope can range from converting an existing garage or bonus room to constructing a brand-new ground-floor wing. Key features often include a dedicated bedroom, a private bathroom with walk-in shower access, a sitting room, and sometimes a kitchenette or separate exterior entrance. Planning early ensures the layout suits long-term accessibility goals while blending seamlessly with your main house architecture.
acceptedAnswer.description: An in-law addition is a dedicated living space featuring a bedroom, bathroom, living area, and sometimes a kitchenette or private entrance to accommodate multigenerational living.
